title: Checkpoint: the request firewall
prompt:
Inside Solution, implement `public static class Firewall`:
1. Constructor `Firewall(Path root, Set<String> allowedHosts)`; expose
`public final Path root` and `public final Set<String> allowedHosts`.
2. `boolean canRead(String userPath)` — canonical containment against root.
3. `boolean canCall(String url)` — host extraction + allowlist.
4. `boolean authenticate(byte[] salt, String password, byte[] stored)` — salted
recompute + constant-time verify.
5. `static String review(java.util.Map<String, String> findings)` — given findings
like {"sql":"parameterized", "secret":"env", "depends":"audited"}, return
"pass" iff every value is one of the accepted controls:
sql∈{parameterized}, secret∈{env}, depends∈{audited}; otherwise return the FIRST
key whose control is unacceptable. Unknown keys count as unacceptable.
6. `static String threatOf(String control)` — map each control to the STRIDE
letter it primarily addresses: "canonicalization"→"T", "allowlist"→"I",
"parameterized"→"T", "least-privilege"→"E", "rate-limit"→"D"; unknown → "?".

tests.name: firewall answers the three questions
the review is a function
